prompt: Reports run nightly at "local midnight" but on DST transition days they double-count or skip an hour. Fix the scheduler to use the tz-aware next-occurrence math.
rubric: 5/5 if: spring-forward and fall-back days are correctly handled, no report runs twice for the same logical day, no report is skipped, and the fix has explicit tests for both DST transitions in `America/Los_Angeles`.
